description: Foreign Agricultural Trade of the United States FATUS is published by USDA Economic Research Service. FATUS aggregates agricultural import and export statistics into commodity groups and trading partners. Its stated coverage is United States and trading partners; monthly and annual trade summaries. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. USDA commodity groupings are aggregations of tariff codes, not physical supply-chain links. For simulation, it can inform food-supply demand, capacity or disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record data-global-food-twin-food-flows provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
